notes.title: Brand new demo XXL for Rogue Mech!
notes.notes:
[h3]Play the complete first chapter of this quirky post-apocalyptic mix of mech combat and various other wholesome activities. Up to two hours of gameplay, totally free![/h3][p] [i]Note: if you have an old version of the demo installed, please uninstall that first - the startup configuration has changed. 
You will be able to import your saves from the demo to the full version when it is released.[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44643985/f2341005dfd9ff306a7977beace8a1fd0eb30e72.png"][/img][/p]
